title: Projection-Free Evolution Strategies for Continuous Prompt Search
abstract: arXiv:2603.13786v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Continuous prompt search offers a computationally efficient alternative to conventional parameter tuning in natural language processing tasks. Nevertheless, its practical effectiveness can be significantly hindered by the black-box nature and the inherent high-dimensionality of the objective landscapes. Existing methods typically mitigate these challenges by restricting the search to a randomly projected low-dimensional subspace. However, the effectiveness and underlying motivation of the projection mechanism remain ambiguous. In this paper, we first empirically demonstrate that despite the prompt space possessing a low-dimensional structure, random projections fail to adequately capture this essential structure. Motivated by this finding, we propose a projection-free prompt search method based on evolutionary strategies. translated_title: 面向连续提示词搜索的无投影演化策略
translated_abstract: 连续提示词搜索为自然语言处理任务中的传统参数微调提供了一种计算高效的替代方案。然而，其现实有效性可能因目标函数景观的黑盒特性和固有的高维性而受到显著阻碍。现有方法通常通过将搜索限制在随机投影后的低维子空间中来缓解这些挑战。然而，投影机制的有效性及其背后的动机仍不明确。在本文中，我们首先通过实证研究表明，尽管提示词空间确实具有低维结构，但随机投影无法充分捕捉这一本质结构。受此发现的启发，我们提出了一种基于演化策略的无投影提示词搜索方法。该方法直接在完整的提示词空间中进行优化，并采用一种根据内在维度进行校准的自适应机制。
tldr: 本文通过实证发现随机投影无法充分捕捉提示词空间的内在低维结构，进而提出一种基于演化策略的无投影连续提示词搜索方法，直接在完整提示词空间中优化并利用与内在维度相适配的自适应机制。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically shows that random projections fail to capture the intrinsic low-dimensional structure of the prompt space, and proposes a projection-free continuous prompt search method based on evolution strategies that directly optimizes in the full prompt space with an adaptation mechanism calibrated to the intrinsic dimensionality.
